name: Horrified
blurb: Team up against classic movie monsters. Everyone wins or loses together.

name: Unmatched
blurb: Fast head-to-head duels between legendary heroes. Easy to learn, quick to replay.

blurb: Explore a haunted house together until one of you turns on the rest.

blurb: Play the villain. Every character has their own goal and their own way to win.

blurb: Build a battlefield, command your army, and fight over the high ground.

name: Chess
blurb: The classic. Open chess nights run Mondays, with a kids hour first.
